source: OpenAlex API /works (IDs written from the response by scripts/run_search.py)
query: ("counter-mapping" OR "participatory mapping" OR "digital mapping") AND (city OR urban OR informal)
filter: title_and_abstract.search.exact:("counter-mapping" OR "participatory mapping" OR "digital mapping") AND (city OR urban OR informal),is_retracted:false,publication_year:2022-2026
oql:
get works where retracted is (false)
  and year >= (2022)
  and year <= (2026)
  and title-abstract has (("digital mapping" OR "participatory mapping" OR "counter-mapping") AND ("city" OR "informal" OR "urban"))
